newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador says Amazon oil spill by old YPF well.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador says Amazon oil spill by old YPF well.

text.p: A fissure in a disused oil well drilled by Argentina's YPF SA has caused a minor spill of crude in the northern Amazon jungle of Ecuador, state-owned Petroecuador said Monday.
"The amount spilt has still not been quantified, but it is not significant and it has not affected native species," a Petroecuador spokesman told Reuters.

He said high-pressure gas seemed to have burst through the concrete that sealed the old well, which was drilled by YPF in 1987 in the province of Sucumbios, 200 km (120 miles) north of Quito on the border with Colombia.
The spokesman said Petroecuador has asked YPF to repair the damage. He did not say when the accident occurred.
Petroecuador is carrying out some clean-up work in the area, even though it has no responsibility for the problem, the spokesman said.
